newsitem.title: USA: Church & Dwight names specialty chief.
newsitem.headline: Church & Dwight names specialty chief.

text.p: Church & Dwight Co Inc said Monday Eugene F. Wilcauskas has been named president of its Specialty Products Division, succeeding Michael Kenney, who left the company several months ago.
The division accounted for $150 million in sales of bicarbonate- and carbonate-based specialty chemicals in 1996.

Wilcauskas was most recently an advisor to Investec Strategies Inc, a private firm that provides advisory services for the development and commercialization of emerging technologies. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
